tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently attended a professional development seminar on communication skills. You found the seminar very valuable and want to follow up with the presenter, Ms. Johnson, to ask for additional resources and express your appreciation for the seminar. Write an email to Ms. Johnson.
bullets: Mention what you found valuable about the seminar.
Ask for additional resources on communication skills.
Express your appreciation for her insights.
tasks.subject: Request for Additional Resources on Communication Skills
